title: nicotiana cirrhoides
intro: Nicotiana cirrhoides, commonly known as Mexican toad plant or Jimsonweed, is a species of flowering plant that is native to Mexico and the southwestern United States. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as relief from coughs, colds, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and bronchodilatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Nicotiana cirrhoides include its ability to act as a sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic, making it useful for treating anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, specifically scopolamine and hyoscyamine, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
